title: The Coastal Heist
description: A tight crew plans an impossible daylight heist along the coast—until the getaway route disappears.

title: Midnight Algorithm
description: A burnt-out engineer discovers an AI that predicts crimes—then sees their own name at the top of the list.

title: Maple Street Stories
description: A warm anthology of neighbors whose small choices ripple through an entire block.

title: Orbit of Echoes
description: A deep-space salvage mission uncovers a broadcast repeating humanity’s final message—sent from the future.

title: Chef on the Run
description: A celebrated chef loses everything and rebuilds with a food truck, one chaotic city at a time.

title: The Last Lighthouse
description: A keeper guards a lighthouse no ship visits—until the fog carries voices that shouldn’t exist.
